dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: Import a Slovenská sporiteľňa export to see your income, spending and 50/30/20 progress.

cards.incomeHint: Transfers between your own accounts are not counted.
cards.netFooterNegative: You spent more than you earned
cards.uncategorizedHintSome: Assign categories on the Transactions page.

rule.title: The 50/30/20 rule
rule.noIncome: No income recorded this month, so no targets can be set.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.hint: Change a category inline to correct it.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Each category belongs to one of the three 50/30/20 buckets. Keywords drive automatic categorization on import.
categories.allDescription: Income and transfer categories are excluded from the 50/30/20 split.

import.title: Import transactions
import.subtitle: Upload a bank export. Transactions are categorized automatically, and anything already imported is skipped.
import.drop: Drop your export here, or choose a file
import.formats: Slovenská sporiteľňa (George) export · .json or .csv · up to 10 MB
import.step1: Open George (Slovenská sporiteľňa) and go to your account.
import.step2: Open the transaction history and choose the period you want.
import.step3: Export it as JSON (preferred) or CSV, then upload the file here.
import.helpNote: Overlapping periods are safe to re-import: each transaction is fingerprinted, so duplicates are skipped rather than added twice.
